{"item_id": "feed:https://www.treelinereview.com/gearreviews/best-mens-down-vests", "version_id": "0f98ede0d27c25831c3a57c3c861c041bfff80673996c8ed6462cb8fb092f848", "decision": "reject", "reason": "Under the Relevance section, this is a clothing item (down and synthetic vests) that could fit the clothing and protection category, but the article is a single-publisher affiliate roundup with no Mammoth connection, and its claims are the reviewer's own impressions rather than measured or independently corroborated results. Under Commercial incentives, the publisher states it operates an affiliate model and may earn commissions, which reduces weight given to its praise, and the article contains no Vortex or other Mammoth sponsor connection. Under Making the decision, the item is unconnected to Mammoth conditions and provides no specific evidence about performance under the carried-load, multi-day conditions defining Mammoth, so it is rejected.", "piece_ids": []}
{"item_id": "feed:https://www.treelinereview.com/gearreviews/best-waterproof-socks", "version_id": "ecf119cf5f407aea8f56f0ce4bf2bd6105c24a28d2e2850c5b2f1de32339379d", "decision": "defer", "reason": "Under Relevance, waterproof socks fall within the rucking and endurance category (socks and foot care), and the reviewer tested them in wet conditions, including a 70-mile rain ride and a 5-mile hike, which speaks to Mammoth-relevant conditions. Under Credibility and Commercial incentives, the publisher uses an affiliate model, the testing is by a single reviewer with no independent corroboration, and the article states the findings are \"based primarily on our hands-on testing\" without publishing measured drying or waterproofing data. Under Making the decision, the evidence is relevant but too thin to rely on yet, with no second independent publisher supporting its central claims, so it is deferred pending stronger evidence.", "piece_ids": []}
